items.title: Pay gas annual bill (Nachzahlung)
items.quote: Bitte gleichen Sie diese Rechnung binnen 30 Kalendertagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum aus; Teilzahlungen sind nach Absprache möglich.
items.computation: Period is 30 calendar days after the Rechnungsdatum (27.11.2026). Under §187(1) BGB the day of the triggering event is excluded, so the period starts 28.11.2026 (day 1). Counting 30 calendar days: day 30 falls on 27.12.2026 (28 Nov to 30 Nov = 3 days, 1 Dec to 27 Dec = 27 days, total 30). Checking the weekday of 27.12.2026: Jan 1, 2026 is a Thursday (non-leap year); day-of-year 361 for 27 Dec gives (361-1) mod 7 = 3, i.e. Thursday+3 = Sunday. Since the last day of the period, 27.12.2026, is a Sunday, §193 BGB shifts the deadline to the next business day. 28.12.2026 (Monday) is not a public holiday in NRW, so the due date becomes 28.12.2026.
